2121332503130886398.en_summary: $META is testing a prediction-market app with employees according to WSJ. Meta employees are testing a new app called Takes, where users make predictions about real-world events using virtual points called “cred” instead of real money. Correct predictions earn points while incorrect ones lose them. One question asks whether former Apple CEO Tim Cook will become Nvidia’s next CEO. The app isn’t publicly available and whether or when it will launch remains unclear.
2121332503130886398.zh_summary: 據WSJ，$META正在與員工測試預測市場應用。Meta員工正在測試名為Takes的新應用，用戶使用稱為「cred」的虛擬點數而非真錢對真實世界事件進行預測。正確預測獲得點數，錯誤則失去。其中一個問題是前蘋果CEO Tim Cook是否會成為英偉達下一任CEO。應用尚未公開，推出時間仍不明確。
